table_party_a = doc.add_table(rows=6, cols=2)

    ('公司名稱：', '_______________________________'),
    ('統一編號：', '_______________________________'),
    ('法定代表人：', '_______________________________'),
    ('聯絡地址：', '_______________________________'),
    ('聯絡電話：', '_______________________________'),
    ('電子郵件：', '_______________________________'),
]

for i, (label, value) in enumerate(party_a_data):

    cell_label = row.cells[0]
    cell_value = row.cells[1]
    cell_label.text = label
    cell_value.text = value
    for cell in [cell_label, cell_value]:
        for paragraph in cell.paragraphs:
            for run in paragraph.runs:
                set_chinese_font(run, 'Microsoft JhengHei', 12)

doc.add_paragraph()

# 乙方資訊區塊
doc.add_heading('乙方資訊', level=1)
table_party_b = doc.add_table(rows=6, cols=2)
table_party_b.style = 'Table Grid'

party_b_data = [
    ('公司名稱：', '_______________________________'),
    ('統一編號：', '_______________________________'),
    ('法定代表人：', '_______________________________'),
    ('聯絡地址：', '_______________________________'),
    ('聯絡電話：', '_______________________________'),
    ('電子郵件：', '_______________________________'),
]

for i, (label, value) in enumerate(party_b_data):
    row = table_party_b.rows[i]
    cell_label = row.cells[0]
    cell_value = row.cells[1]
    cell_label.text = label
    cell_value.text = value
    for cell in [cell_label, cell_value]:
        for paragraph in cell.paragraphs:
            for run in paragraph.runs:
                set_chinese_font(run, 'Microsoft JhengHei', 12)

doc.add_paragraph()

# 合約基本資訊
doc.add_heading('合約基本資訊', level=1)

info_table = doc.add_table(rows=4, cols=2)
info_table.style = 'Table Grid'

info_data = [
    ('合約名稱：', '_______________________________'),
    ('合約金額：', '_______________________________'),
    ('合約起始日：', '_______________________________'),
    ('合約終止日：', '_______________________________'),
]

for i, (label, value) in enumerate(info_data):
    row = info_table.rows[i]
    row.cells[0].text = label
    row.cells[1].text = value
    for cell in [row.cells[0], row.cells[1]]:
        for paragraph in cell.paragraphs:
            for run in paragraph.runs:
                set_chinese_font(run, 'Microsoft JhengHei', 12)

doc.add_paragraph()

# 條款內容預留區
doc.add_heading('合約條款', level=1)
doc.add_paragraph('（以下預留空間供填寫合約條款內容）')
doc.add_paragraph()

for i in range(8):
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    p.add_run(f'第 {i+1} 條 ________________________________________________________________')
    for run in p.runs:
        set_chinese_font(run, 'Microsoft JhengHei', 12)

doc.add_paragraph()
doc.add_paragraph()

# 簽名區
doc.add_heading('簽名欄', level=1)

sign_table = doc.add_table(rows=3, cols=2)
sign_table.style = 'Table Grid'

sign_data = [
    ('甲方（簽章）：', '                        '),
    ('乙方（簽章）：', '                        '),
    ('日期：', '                        '),
]

for i, (label, value) in enumerate(sign_data):
    row = sign_table.rows[i]
    row.cells[0].text = label
    row.cells[1].text = value
    for cell in [row.cells[0], row.cells[1]]:
        for paragraph in cell.paragraphs:
            for run in paragraph.runs:
                set_chinese_font(run, 'Microsoft JhengHei', 12)

# 保存文件
doc.save('/tmp/contract.docx')
print('合約範本已建立: /tmp/contract.docx')
